children: Jones Trading maintained their Buy rating on Real REMAX Group's stock with a price target of $40.00.
The price target implies an upside of 132.4% from the Sep 21 close of $17.21.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Real REMAX Group is expected to exceed its initial $30 million synergy target due to operational efficiencies identified post-merger, which include cost reductions and improved productivity among its agent base. This positive outlook on synergies enhances the company's financial prospects and justifies a Buy rating.

: The company has benefited from a more productive agent base following a 15% reduction in the overall number of agents in the industry. With REMAX agents closing an average of 12 transactions per year compared to lower figures at competitors, this productivity advantage positions Real REMAX Group favorably in a challenging market environment.
